title: roammate vs Couchsurfing: What's the Difference?
description: roammate and Couchsurfing both connect travellers, but they solve completely different problems. Here's how to choose the right tool for what you actually need.
intro: roammate and Couchsurfing both connect travellers — but they solve fundamentally different problems. Couchsurfing is a hospitality network built around accommodation. roammate is a travel companion app built around compatible matching. Using the wrong tool for the wrong job means either sleeping on a stranger's couch when you wanted a hiking partner, or searching a general social network when you need someone who matches your travel pace, budget, and style. This guide explains the difference clearly so you can choose the right one.

sections.heading: What Couchsurfing Actually Is
sections.content: Couchsurfing is a global hospitality network where hosts offer free accommodation to travellers (surfers) in exchange for cultural exchange. The core transaction is a free place to stay with a local who wants to share their city. Couchsurfing also has a Hangouts feature — a separate tab where travellers and locals in a city can signal they're available to meet for coffee, a walk, or a meal. This is the part of Couchsurfing that most closely resembles what roammate does, though the similarity stops there. Couchsurfing's primary value is accommodation and local connection; the social features are secondary to its hospitality mission. The platform went behind a paywall in 2020 (around $15/year), which significantly reduced active users particularly outside major Western cities.

sections.heading: What roammate Actually Is
sections.content: roammate is a travel companion matching app. There is no accommodation exchange. The purpose is to find another traveller heading to the same destination who matches your travel style, daily budget, and itinerary — so you can share experiences, split costs, and travel together rather than solo. The matching logic is the key difference: roammate filters by travel style (adventure, cultural immersion, slow travel, food-focused), budget bracket, and destination overlap before surfacing any profiles. This means you're not scrolling through everyone in a city — you're seeing people who already pass a compatibility filter. roammate is free on iOS and Android with no subscription required.
